title: Steve Jobs rare footage conducting a presentation on 1980 (Insanely Great)
summary: Rare footage of Steve Jobs giving a 22 minute presentation about Apple in 1980, donated to the Computer History Museum. In it he explains the company name and the bicycle-for-the-mind idea for computers.
why: HN commenters cite it as proof that Jobs was a polished speaker from the start and quote its analogies about computers and people.

quote.text: Here's another presentation he did in 1980 that shows he had these skills almost from the very beginning
